Class SustenanceEventCard

java.lang.Object
model.cards.Card
model.cards.TribeCard
model.cards.eventCards.EventCard
model.cards.eventCards.SustenanceEventCard
public class SustenanceEventCard extends EventCard
Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Sustenance phase.

This event class implements the core economic maintenance check of the game engine, requiring each player to allocate resources to feed their entire accumulated population. The algorithm aggregates structural discounts from gatherer characters and queries active building effects to mitigate costs. Any unbacked population deficit triggers a compounding resource debt evaluation that converts into prestige penalties scaled by the active Era.

    resolve(List<Player> players)
    Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline: Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1. Iterates through each active game participant to evaluate demographic maintenance prerequisites. Baseline Discount Compilation: Retrieves the initial resource discount yielded inherently by gatherer cards inside the tribe via Tribe.getTotalGatherersDiscount(). Building Hook Interception: Dispatches a polling loop to all registered OnEventBuildingEffect instances via OnEventBuildingEffect.applyOnSustenance(Player) to accumulate additional structural or conditional food cost reductions. Requirement Balancing: Calculates the net required food as Math.max(0, population - discount). Penalty Resolution: If the net requirement strictly exceeds zero, delegates the subtraction to Player.removeFoodWithPrestigePenalty(int, int), which exhausts the current food inventory before applying a converted prestige point loss scaled by eraIndex. State Serialization: Packages individual asset deltas and details metrics into client-bound PlayerEventDeltaDto data wrappers.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public EventResolutionDto resolve(List<Player> players)
      Algorithmic Resolution Pipeline:
      1. Computes the chronological scaling index: eraIndex = era.ordinal() + 1.
      2. Iterates through each active game participant to evaluate demographic maintenance prerequisites.
      3. Baseline Discount Compilation: Retrieves the initial resource discount yielded inherently by gatherer cards inside the tribe via Tribe.getTotalGatherersDiscount().
      4. Building Hook Interception: Dispatches a polling loop to all registered OnEventBuildingEffect instances via OnEventBuildingEffect.applyOnSustenance(Player) to accumulate additional structural or conditional food cost reductions.
      5. Requirement Balancing: Calculates the net required food as Math.max(0, population - discount).
      6. Penalty Resolution: If the net requirement strictly exceeds zero, delegates the subtraction to Player.removeFoodWithPrestigePenalty(int, int), which exhausts the current food inventory before applying a converted prestige point loss scaled by eraIndex.
      7. State Serialization: Packages individual asset deltas and details metrics into client-bound PlayerEventDeltaDto data wrappers.
      Specified by:
      resolve in class EventCard
      Parameters:
      players - the active list of Player instances participating in the game
      Returns:
      a fully populated, serialized network transport object EventResolutionDto summarizing the phase outcomes
